#Load libraries

```{r}
library(viridis)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(ggplot2)
library(cowplot)
library(data.table)
library(tidyverse)
```
#Categorize features
```{r}
test_chem_cc <- fread(
  file.path(pipeline_output_path, "test_chem_cc.csv")
)
cell_count <- as.data.frame(test_chem_cc)

#ASK EUNNARA i just added 1 to everyone
cell_count$Metadata_Concentration <- cell_count$Metadata_Concentration + 1

#I added group by plate to everything
cell_count_avg <- cell_count %>%
  group_by(Metadata_Chemical, Metadata_Concentration, Metadata_Plate) %>%
  summarise(Average_cc = mean(cell_count),
            SD = sd(cell_count))

cell_count_avg$relative_cc <- cell_count_avg$Average_cc/cell_count_avg[cell_count_avg$Metadata_Chemical== ctrl_group, ]$Average_cc

cell_count_avg$SD_rel_cc <- cell_count_avg$relative_cc*sqrt((cell_count_avg$SD/cell_count_avg$Average_cc)^2 + (cell_count_avg[cell_count_avg$Metadata_Chemical == ctrl_group, ]$SD/cell_count_avg[cell_count_avg$Metadata_Chemical == ctrl_group, ]$Average_cc)^2)
#####cut-off for reduction in cell count#####
cytotoxic_conc <- cell_count_avg %>%
  filter(relative_cc < 0.5)
```
#Plotting
```{r}
relative_cell_count <- ggplot(cell_count_avg[cell_count_avg$Metadata_Chemical != ctrl_group,], aes(x = Metadata_Concentration, y = relative_cc, colour = Metadata_Chemical)) +
    geom_point() +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = relative_cc - SD_rel_cc, ymax = relative_cc + SD_rel_cc), width = 0.05) +
    theme_bw() + 
    theme(legend.position="none") +
    scale_x_log10() +
    ylim(0, 1.6) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
    facet_wrap(vars(Metadata_Chemical), scales = "free")
relative_cell_count
plate_no <- unique(cell_count$Metadata_Plate)

plate_plot <- lapply(plate_no, function(x){
  
  plate_data <- cell_count[cell_count$Metadata_Plate == x, ]
  
  # Create an ordered factor for Chemical with ctrl_group first
  plate_data$Metadata_Chemical <- factor(plate_data$Metadata_Chemical, 
                                levels = c(ctrl_group, setdiff(unique(plate_data$Metadata_Chemical), ctrl_group)), 
                                ordered = TRUE)
  
  y_min <- min(plate_data[plate_data$Metadata_Chemical == ctrl_group,]$cell_count)
  y_max <- max(plate_data[plate_data$Metadata_Chemical == ctrl_group,]$cell_count)
  
  plate_plot <- ggplot(plate_data, aes(x=Metadata_Concentration, y=cell_count, colour=Metadata_Chemical)) + 
    geom_point() + 
   # geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = relative_cc - SD_rel_cc, ymax = relative_cc + SD_rel_cc), width = 0.05) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = y_min, ymax = y_max), fill = "grey70", alpha = 0.5) +        
    geom_hline(yintercept = median(plate_data[plate_data$Metadata_Chemical == ctrl_group,]$cell_count), linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
    scale_y_continuous() +
    ylim(min(plate_data$cell_count)-50, max(plate_data$cell_count)+50) +
    scale_x_log10() +
    theme(legend.position="none") +
    scale_color_brewer(palette = "Paired") +
    geom_text(aes(label = Metadata_Well), size = 2, vjust = -1, hjust = 0.5) +
    facet_wrap(vars(Metadata_Chemical), scales = "free") +
    ggtitle(paste0("Plate ", x))
  
    plate_plot
  }) 

nrow <- length(plate_no)

combined_plot <- do.call(plot_grid, c(plate_plot, nrow = nrow))

ggsave(file.path(plots, "Cell count by chemical_all plates.png"), combined_plot, width = 20, height = 60,units = "cm")

ggsave(file.path(plots,"Relative cell count.png"), relative_cell_count, width = 50, height = 30, units = "cm")

ctrl_plot <- ggplot(cell_count[cell_count$Metadata_Chemical == ctrl_group,], aes(x= as.character(Metadata_Plate), y=cell_count, colour=Metadata_Plate)) + 
  geom_point() + 
  scale_y_continuous() +
  theme(legend.position="none") +
  xlab("Plate Number") +
  ylab("Cell count") +
  geom_text(aes(label = Metadata_Well), size = 2, vjust = -1, hjust = 0.5) +
  ggtitle(paste0("Vehicle Control (",ctrl_group, ")"))

ctrl_plot
ggsave(file.path(plots, "Cell count_ctrl_all plates.png"), ctrl_plot, width = 20, height = 60,units = "cm")

## Cell density heatmap

plate_cell_count <- test_chem_cc

plate_cell_count <- plate_cell_count %>%
  mutate(Metadata_Well = str_trim(Metadata_Well)) %>%
  separate(Metadata_Well, into = c("Row", "Column"), sep = "(?<=^.)") %>%
  separate(Column, into = c("Column", "Metadata_Plate"), sep = "_", fill = "right", extra = "merge")

plate_cell_count$Column <- factor(plate_cell_count$Column, levels = as.character(1:12))

plate_cell_count$Row <- factor(plate_cell_count$Row, levels = LETTERS[8:1])

cellcount_hm <- ggplot(plate_cell_count, aes(x = Column, y = Row, fill = cell_count)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_viridis_c() +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(title = element_text(size = 13),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16, margin = margin(t=15)),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16, margin = margin(r=15)),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14, colour = "black"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14, colour = "black", margin=margin(r=5)),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 15),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 13, colour = "black")) +
  labs(title = "Cell count across 9 fields of view (96-well plate)", x = "Columns", y = "Rows", fill = "Cell Count") +
  facet_grid(rows=vars(Metadata_Plate))

cellcount_hm
```

#Features
```{r}
test_chem_well <- fread(
  file.path(pipeline_output_path, "test_chem_well.csv")
)

test_chem_well <- as.data.frame(test_chem_well)
variances <- apply(test_chem_well, 2, var)
variances[1:7] <- 1

test_chem_well <- test_chem_well[, variances != 0 & !is.na(variances)]

feature_cols  <- test_chem_well[, 5:ncol(test_chem_well)]
  
features <- data.frame(feature = colnames(test_chem_well[-c(1:4)])) %>%
  mutate(
    module   = str_extract(feature, "^[^_]+"),
    specific = str_extract(feature, "(?<=_)[^_]+"),

    channel1 = case_when(
      module == "Correlation" ~
        str_match(
          feature,
          "^Correlation_[^_]+_(AGP|ER|DNA|Mito|RNA)_(AGP|ER|DNA|Mito|RNA)_"
        )[, 2],
      TRUE ~ str_extract(feature, "(?<=_)(AGP|ER|DNA|Mito|RNA)(?=_)")
    ),

    channel2 = case_when(
      module == "Correlation" ~
        str_match(
          feature,
          "^Correlation_[^_]+_(AGP|ER|DNA|Mito|RNA)_(AGP|ER|DNA|Mito|RNA)_"  #for correlation there are 2 channels
        )[, 3],
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
 specific = case_when(
  module == "Granularity" ~ "Granularity",
  TRUE ~ str_extract(feature, "(?<=_)[^_]+")  #no specifics in granulairy 
),
    region = str_extract(feature, "[^_]+$")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    region = ifelse(
      region %in% c("cells", "cytoplasm", "nuclei"),
      region,
      NA_character_
    )
  )

# Morphology / shape features
features$specific[features$specific %in% c("BoundingBoxArea","EquivalentDiameter","MajorAxisLength","MinorAxisLength","MaxFeretDiameter","MinFeretDiameter","MaximumRadius","MeanRadius","MedianRadius","Perimeter","Compactness","Eccentricity","Extent","FormFactor","Solidity","Orientation", "Area")] <- "Morphology"


# Spatial / neighborhood organization
features$specific[features$specific %in% c("AngleBetweenNeighbors","FirstClosestDistance","FirstClosestObjectNumber","PercentTouching","SecondClosestDistance","SecondClosestObjectNumber")] <- "Spatial"

# Subcellular organization / texture-like features
features$specific[features$specific %in% c("FracAtD", "RadialCV", "MeanFrac")] <- "SubcellularOrganization"

# Positional metadata
features$specific[features$specific %in% c( "BoundingBoxMaximum","BoundingBoxMinimum","Center")] <- "Position"

#Add category number i have 77
features <- features %>%
  group_by(region, specific, channel1, channel2, module) %>%
  mutate(cat_group = cur_group_id()) %>%
  mutate(ft_no = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup()

ft_colnames <- features %>%
  dplyr::select(region, specific, channel1, channel2, module, cat_group, ft_no)

#Concatenate region, channel, and module
ft_colnames2 <- apply(
  ft_colnames[, c("region", "specific", "channel1", "channel2", "module")],
  1,
  \(x) paste(na.omit(x), collapse = "_")
)
ft_colnames2 <- as.data.frame(ft_colnames2)
colnames(ft_colnames2) <- "features"

sample_info <- as.data.frame(colnames(test_chem_well[c(1:4)]))
colnames(sample_info) <- "features"
colnames(ft_colnames2) <- "features"

fts <- rbind(sample_info, ft_colnames2)

#Replace the original features names with the reformatted feature names
colnames(test_chem_well) <- t(fts) # run code up to here for BMDExpress formatting

#remove individual metadate collomns
#i added plate
test_chem_well$Chemical <- paste0(test_chem_well$Metadata_Chemical, "_",test_chem_well$Metadata_Concentration, "_", test_chem_well$Metadata_Well, "_",test_chem_well$Metadata_Plate)

test_chem_well <- test_chem_well[, !names(test_chem_well) %in% c("Metadata_Plate", "Metadata_Well","Metadata_Concentration", "Metadata_Chemical")]

##make chemicals info the row name
rows <- test_chem_well$Chemical

rownames(test_chem_well) <- rows

test_chem_well <- test_chem_well %>%
  dplyr::select(-Chemical)

```
